sentences.text: However, the petitioner preferred a revision and sought time to address on the issue of maintainability of the revision.
On the said date, the petitioner could not appear before the learned Court below and in absence of the petitioner, the matter was fixed for the next date as 19.12.2024.

The petitioner was not aware about the next date fixed by the court blow and due to this reason, he could not appear before the Court below and in absence of the petitioner, the revision of the petitioner was dismissed vide impugned order dated 19.12.2024.
It has been further submitted that an opportunity be given to the petitioner to raise his grievance before the court concerned on the ground of maintainability of the revision of the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice, a fresh opportunity be given to the petitioner to raise his grievance before the court concerned on the ground of maintainability of the revision of the petitioner.
With the aforesaid directions, the instant petition stands disposed of.
